description: The code-path analyzer treats every logical expression as && or ||.

provenance.construction: reverse of f93d6ff53a: the new side of the diff is the code before the change; 7 explanatory line(s) deleted from the old side were dropped so the diff does not explain the fix

expected.rationale: The deleted filter limited choice-context handling to && and ||. Any other logical operator, such as the nullish coalescing operator ??, now pushes and pops a context as if it were one of them, which ends in an 'unreachable' error and makes the linter fail on valid modern code, as the linked issue reports. A crash on valid input is HIGH. This level is a judgement, not an advisory rating.

issues.description: pushChoiceContext runs for every LogicalExpression, whatever its operator, and the matching right-operand and pop handling no longer check the operator either.
